contract: Typed integer/fixed decimal input never passes through Number

Finite typed scalar curves explicitly approximate to float64; original exact values remain in result/history/exports
No plotted bridge through special or unsupported typed samples
Original 39 example IDs and 6 categories retained; 6 typed examples added
